usage.title: Reading a key
usage.lead: Code in any workspace reads a key by its name.

security.title: Security
security.encrypted: Keys are encrypted at rest with AES (pgcrypto) and never stored in plaintext.
security.agent: The Agent can't read a key's value directly; it can only call {{call}} inside sandboxed code.
security.leakScan: Everything the Agent's tools return is scanned for leaks, and a key's value found there is redacted before it reaches the model.
security.store: Code validation blocks direct file access to stored keys; only the {{module}} API is allowed.
